title: Lids leak
text: Lids leak. I really like the size and design of these insulated mugs. They are easy to hold, not too heavy, and the outside stays dry with cold liquid in them. The biggest thing, and a real deal breaker for me, is that the lids leak if the silicone gasket gets the least little bit displaced. And it gets displaced VERY easily. It seems the gasket is a bit too small, and each time the lid is opened, it falls out. Getting it back in place is difficult. I ended up running the lid and gasket under hot water and putting the gasket in place and quickly closing the lid. This seems to work most of the time, but it's a pain in the neck to keep having to do this.  The lids are definitely the bad part of these mugs. Need a better design. Thinking about sending them back.
